description: Persist an explicit user deferment for one Trackly job or its derived company or provider scope. Provider scope applies across companies until explicitly cleared. The server derives company, provider, tenant, origin, and route from jobId; never submit a provider name, URL, or free text.

context.description: Briefly explain why this tool helps the current job-search goal. Never include resume text, profile answers, demographic or work-authorization answers, application notes, credentials, or secrets.

name: trackly_defer_apply_access
